# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 26 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 36 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_026_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 26

**1** Jesus said: "You see the splinter in your brother's eye, but you do not see the beam in your own eye.

**2** When you remove the beam from your own eye, then you will see clearly to remove the splinter from your brother's eye."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Splinter" and "beam" — the extreme contrast; a chip vs. a structural timber
- "Remove the beam" — the self-correction must come first
- "See clearly" — the word for revelation/manifestation (*ouōnh*) is used; clearing one's own vision is an act of disclosure
- P.Oxy 1 lines 1-4 confirms the Greek parallel
